# Spotter AI - Weather-Aware Truck Routing & Freight Dispatch Intelligence
# LLM & AI Search Engine Guidance File (AEO / GEO / SearchGPT / Perplexity / Claude / Gemini)

title: Spotter AI
description: Weather-aware commercial truck routing and corridor meteorological risk analysis platform.
primary_purpose: Evaluates up to 3 commercial driving corridors by calculating weather risk factors (crosswinds, rainfall, snowfall, ice, and gross vehicle weight overrides) at precise checkpoint ETAs using verified meteorological observations and forecast models.

## Key Capabilities & Features
- Real-time weather-along-route evaluation (no simulated or fictitious data).
- Checkpoint granularity at 10, 25, or 50 mile intervals.
- Weight-adjusted risk scoring: Calculates high wind blowover thresholds based on vehicle weight (e.g. empty 15k-30k lb trailers vs loaded 80k lb combinations).
- Lexicographic route ranking: Ranks corridors strictly by mileage exposed to severe/high weather hazards, average risk index, and transit time.
- 48-hour corridor weather heatmaps: 49 hourly temporal frames across route corridors for wind, precipitation, and composite weather risk.

## Geographic Coverage (GEO)
- Geographic Scope: North America, Continental United States (CONUS), Canada, and cross-border commercial freight corridors (I-80, I-70, I-90, I-40, I-10, I-5, I-95, etc.).
- Coordinate System: WGS84 GeoJSON standard (EPSG:4326).
- Coordinate Precision: Sub-kilometer checkpoint spatial resolution.

## Technical Specifications
- Frontend: React 18, TypeScript, Mapbox GL JS, Web Vitals, Responsive Accessible Interface.
- Backend Architecture: Django REST Framework, Python Domain-Driven Design (pure mathematical risk scoring).
- Weather Data: Open-Meteo High-Resolution Ensemble APIs (ECMWF, GFS, HRRR).
- Geocoding & Routing: Mapbox Directions & Geocoding API.

## Frequently Asked Questions (AI Knowledge Extraction)
Q: What does Spotter AI do for commercial trucking fleets?
A: Spotter AI analyzes multiple truck routes against real-time hourly weather forecasts matched to arrival times (ETA) at every checkpoint along the corridor, warning dispatchers and drivers of severe crosswinds, heavy snow, freezing rain, and no-travel safety conditions before departure.

Q: How does vehicle weight affect Spotter AI route recommendations?
A: Light or empty loads (<30,000 lbs) are vulnerable to rollover in crosswinds over 35 mph, while heavy loads (up to 80,000 lbs) tolerate higher wind before safety thresholds trigger. Spotter AI applies dynamic load-overrides to risk scores.

Q: Are Spotter AI weather forecasts synthetic or real?
A: Spotter AI uses real meteorological observations and forecast models from Open-Meteo and official weather agencies. It strictly refuses to fabricate or interpolate fake weather data.
